user_story.i_want: field history tracking enabled on AAR objects
user_story.so_that: we have full audit trails of who changed what content and when, supporting accountability and compliance requirements

reclassified_as_checklist.decision: Do NOT treat as standalone sprint story. Convert to checklist task within BH-987 (data model story). Developer ticks field history boxes in Setup before closing BH-987.
reclassified_as_checklist.rationale: Implementation is ~entirely Setup UI clicks (Object Manager → Fields & Relationships → Set History Tracking) plus one custom report type. 2 story points.
reclassified_as_checklist.documentation_note: Keep the detailed field-by-field spec in this story as REFERENCE DOCUMENTATION.

evaluator_field_conflict.decision: REMOVE all Evaluator_1_* and Evaluator_2_* fields from AAR_Record__c tracking list. Those fields are NOT on AAR_Record__c — per BH-1246, evaluator state lives on a separate AAR_Evaluation__c object.
evaluator_field_conflict.replacement: Configure field history on AAR_Evaluation__c (Rating__c, Status__c, Evaluation_Date__c at minimum)
evaluator_field_conflict.impact: AAR_Record__c tracked-field count drops from 20 to ~14 (core/content/metadata only)

data_protection_clarification.decision: Do NOT frame Shield as the data recovery backstop. Shield = audit + field history + 7-year retention. Hourly org backups = point-in-time recovery. They are complementary, not redundant.
data_protection_clarification.dod_update: Note that backup recovery is handled at the org level independently of this story.

shield_benefits_used: 60 fields per object (vs 20 standard) — expansion capacity
7 years retention (vs 18 months) — multi-year trend analysis
Field Audit Trail — extended retention for critical compliance fields

evaluator_review_REMOVED.note: REMOVED per Mar 2026 conflict resolution — these fields do not exist on AAR_Record__c. Configure on AAR_Evaluation__c instead.

AAR_Evaluation__c.source: Added per Mar 2026 evaluator conflict resolution (was not in original spec)
AAR_Evaluation__c.reference_ticket: BH-1246 (defines AAR_Evaluation__c: Lookup to AAR_Record__c, Evaluator__c User Lookup, Rating__c, Strengths__c, Concerns__c, Recommendations__c, Evaluation_Date__c, Status__c)

AAR_Recognition__c.note: Manual entry only — no Source__c or Is_Verified__c fields needed

tracked_fields.rationale: Track source attribution (Manual Entry vs ORCID)

AAR_Scholarly_Output__c.conditional: Only if polymorphic design retained (Phase 2). Per BH-987 Mar 2026 MVP revision, type-specific fields deferred to V1.1 — confirm object exists in MVP scope.

Commercialization__c.conditional: Per BH-1121, object is shell-only until Wellspring CSV arrives. Only Title__c exists in MVP shell — other tracked fields apply post-CSV.

standard_audit_fields_automatic.note: Auto-tracked on ALL objects — do NOT count toward 60-field limit

simplified_attestation_pattern.principle: Field history makes separate Completed_By__c / Completed_Date__c fields unnecessary
simplified_attestation_pattern.delegate_activity: LastModifiedById shows delegate user in field history
simplified_attestation_pattern.pi_signoff: Attested_By__c must equal PI's user account

sample_soql: SELECT Id, Field, OldValue, NewValue, CreatedById, CreatedDate FROM AAR_Record__History WHERE ParentId = :aarRecordId ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC
definition_of_done: Field history tracking enabled on all AAR objects
~14 fields configured on AAR_Record__c (revised from 20 — evaluator fields moved to AAR_Evaluation__c)
Field history configured on AAR_Evaluation__c (Rating__c, Status__c, Evaluation_Date__c)
History retention set to 7 years (Shield configuration)
Key fields configured on junction objects (Recognition, Publication, Commercialization)
Custom report type created: 'AAR Records with Field History'
Test validation: Create AAR, edit key fields, verify history captured
Documentation updated with field history access instructions and Shield retention policy
DoD does NOT frame Shield as data recovery backstop — backup recovery is handled at org level independently (hourly backups)
setup_path: Setup → Object Manager → AAR_Record__c → Fields & Relationships → Set History Tracking
field_selection_criteria: Verification fields (Source__c, Is_Verified__c on junctions where applicable)

storage_estimates.assumptions: 400 PIs × avg 5 changes per field × 7 years × ~1KB per history record

effort_breakdown.task: Create custom report type and test

dependencies: Epic BH-1116 (Core Data Model) — AAR objects must exist first
Shield implementation approved and configured (platform dependency)

decision_log.decision: Reclassified as admin config checklist task. Recommendation: fold into BH-987 rather than running as a standalone sprint story. Keep field-level spec as reference documentation.
Remove evaluator fields from AAR_Record__c tracking list — they don't exist on that object per BH-1246. Configure history on AAR_Evaluation__c instead. AAR_Record__c field count: 20 → ~14.
Clarified data protection strategy: Shield + hourly org backups (complementary, not redundant). Update DoD to not frame Shield as the recovery backstop.
